items.english: The surface representing the values of w then becomes a parallelogram whose sides are the p-th pair (a, b) and from which (p−1) parallelograms are cut out.

items.quote:

$\partial^2 K$
entsprechen.
items.english: Consideration of this case is necessary for investigating the differential equations that correspond to the known differential equation ∂²K.
